sources.quote: 4.2 A supplier may deliver a part only if the approved supplier list contains an approval for that
the audit qualifies the company. Part approvals stay as they are.

findings.why: The ASL covers BR-225 at PLT-BEI for CUST-AUR, but only for SUP-B. There is no approval for SUP-C. The re-audit qualifies the company only and does not approve any part.

sources.quote: 7.1 The supplier shall obtain written approval from Aurelia (PPAP resubmission) before shipping parts

findings.why: BR-225 belongs to PRG-X, which is an Aurelia program. Revision 4 of the Aurelia manual requires written approval (PPAP resubmission) for a change of source. It also requires 90 days' notice and gives approval per part and per site. Nothing in force covers this change.

cracks around fastening holes on brackets machined from EN AW-6082 material delivered by
The 8D on the 6082 cracks is not closed yet

findings.why: SUP-C has an open 8D on EN AW-6082 material. BR-225 is drawn in EN AW-6082-T6.

sources.quote: Chisone is qualified for 6061-T6 and 6082-T5 only.
SC-BR225-YS,BR-225,Yield strength Rp0.2 at least 250 MPa,250

findings.why: The drawing requires 6082-T6 with a yield of at least 250 MPa. SUP-C is qualified only for 6061-T6 and 6082-T5. The master lists 6082-T5 at a typical yield of 230 MPa, below 250. SUP-C has no 6082-T6 capability.

sources.quote: 4.4 A change of source requires a material certificate (EN 10204 type 3.1) from the new supplier for

findings.why: No 3.1 certificate from SUP-C for MAT-6082-T6 is on file. SUP-C's certificates cover only 6061-T6 and 6082-T5. The supplier quality engineer (PER-GALLO) must answer.
